verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents fine-grained role-based access control over its resources (flagsmith-docs-11). It also documents restricting who can modify production environments (flagsmith-docs-26), which covers the roles-and-permissions core of the story. Nothing in the pack shows scoped or role-bound Admin API tokens; the only key described is the public, non-secret client Environment Key (flagsmith-docs-15), which is not a permission-scoped token. Missing for 10: documented scoped API tokens, per-flag permission granularity detail, independent/hands-on corroboration of RBAC.
